title: Obsidian vault
about: For notes kept in an Obsidian vault: the vault, daily notes and an inbox.

sections.title: Vault
sections.text: Name the vault folder in settings notes_roots, then show its notes here.

sections.title: Daily notes
sections.text: Today's note and the last few days. A folders item lists the daily notes folder.

sections.title: Inbox
sections.text: Notes waiting to be filed. A data tile can count them for you.
